loyalty.title: Customers
loyalty.intro: Loyalty members, their ledgers, the cases a manager decides and unusual loyalty activity by shift. Phone numbers are always masked.
loyalty.demo: This section needs live data: the demo has no members, ledgers or queue. When a store runs the loyalty programme, this page shows its members, each member's ledger, the cases to reconcile and anomalies by shift.
loyalty.readOnly.role: This page is for the owner, managers and viewers only.
loyalty.metrics.slot.title: Customer metrics
loyalty.metrics.slot.body: The customer metric cards and the member capture rate on invoices will appear here once the customer metrics are built.
loyalty.lookup.title: Look up by phone
loyalty.lookup.hint: Enter a customer's phone to open their ledger. The result stays masked.
loyalty.lookup.hintOwner: Enter a customer's phone to open their ledger. For the owner, the result shows the full number to check with the customer; the number is never put in the page address.
loyalty.lookup.invalid: This phone number cannot be read.
loyalty.lookup.failed: The lookup failed. Try again later.
loyalty.members.title: Members
loyalty.members.caption: Members
loyalty.members.countMore: Showing the {count} newest members; press Show more to load the next ones.
loyalty.members.scopeNote: Stamps and points come from the ledger rows of the stores you can see; a manager of some stores may see less than the real balance.
loyalty.path.D: D · Reward code on the invoice
loyalty.ledger.title: Ledger
loyalty.ledger.caption: Member ledger
loyalty.ledger.note: Every stamp or point movement is a row; a mistake is corrected by a new row and the old row stays.
loyalty.member.heading: Member {phone}
loyalty.member.missing: This member was not found or you cannot see it.
loyalty.queue.intro: A check-in or receipt claim matched two or more invoices, so nothing was guessed. Choose the right invoice to earn, or dismiss the case; always give a reason.
loyalty.queue.denied: Only the owner and store managers see and resolve the reconciliation queue.
loyalty.queue.checkin: Staff recorded the check-in code at {time}
loyalty.queue.checkinAmount: Staff recorded the check-in code at {time}, {amount}
loyalty.queue.reason.label: Resolution reason
loyalty.queue.reason.hint: Required, at most {max} characters; for example the customer showed the paper receipt.
loyalty.queue.error.reasonLength: A reason holds at most 200 characters.
loyalty.queue.error.invalid: This case is already closed or the choice is not valid. Reload the page to see its state.
loyalty.queue.done.refused: Resolved, but the invoice did not earn: {reason}.
loyalty.queue.history.title: Recently resolved
loyalty.queue.history.caption: Resolved cases
loyalty.anomalies.title: Loyalty activity by shift
loyalty.anomalies.intro: Each row is one shift (Shift 1, Shift 2… by opening time): earns, refusals by reason, manual adjustments and check-ins that matched no invoice. Rows with signals to review come first.
loyalty.anomalies.caption: Loyalty activity by shift
loyalty.anomalies.none: No loyalty activity in this range.
loyalty.anomalies.sentence: {shifts} shifts with activity, {flagged} to review: {earns} earns, {refusals} refusals, {adjustments} manual adjustments, {checkins} check-ins without an invoice.
